summary: 3D local-to-world coordinate transform on a camera-like object. Builds a combined offset vector by adding the camera-relative offset (this[573..575]) to an additional position offset (this[576..578]), multiplies it by a 3x3 rotation matrix (this[8..16], byte offset 0x20-0x40) into the output vector a2, adds the base position (this[2..4], byte offset 0x8-0x10), copies the 3x3 matrix block into a local buffer, then calls sub_567120(this+579, a3) whose return value is passed through. Invoked by CameraModeViewportUpdate (00409A00).

local_names.this: camera object carrying base position, rotation matrix and two offset vectors
local_names.v8: 36-byte stack buffer receiving a copy of the 3x3 matrix block; not otherwise used

operations.description: Computes the combined offset vector: v4 = this[573]+this[576], v5 = this[574]+this[577], v6 = this[575]+this[578] (camera-relative offset 0x8F4/0x8F8/0x8FC summed with additional offset 0x900/0x904/0x908)
Applies the 3x3 rotation matrix: output a2[0..2] = each row of this[8..16] (offsets 0x20-0x40) dotted with the combined offset vector (v4, v5, v6)
Translates the rotated vector by the base position: a2[0] += this[2], a2[1] += this[3], a2[2] += this[4] (offsets 0x8/0xC/0x10)
Copies the 3x3 matrix block from this+8 (36 bytes, offsets 0x20-0x40) into a local 36-byte stack buffer v8; the buffer is never read afterward
Calls sub_567120 with the pointer to this[579] (the combined offset vector) and forwards a3; result is returned to the caller
Returns the int result produced by sub_567120
Invoked by CameraModeViewportUpdate (00409A00), indicating a camera-viewport path
